Quick brand suggestion · Avira Bedi · Nov 2026
Organic engine

Creators bring Sova reach. Now Sova needs a voice of its own.

Sova’s creator collabs are working. What’s missing is an organic engine the brand owns, and right now the comments under those collabs are working against it.

2.1Mviews on Sova’s best creator reel, Aug–Nov
8average likes + comments on Sova’s own posts
0brand replies across its 9 biggest reels
KeepGapProofAddFixMeasure
Keep

Creator collabs work. Keep them.

25 of Sova’s 31 posts from Aug–Nov were co-posted with creators. Five reels carried the account: 2.1M, 355k, 270k, 137k and 88k views. First-person confession hooks did best (“Blaming your acidity on stress? Yeah, same”).

The rest of the category works the same way. Decode Age leans on Mandira Bedi, The Good Bug on singer Shaan, Happy Cultures on recipe creators. For reach, creators are the right engine.

Gap

What’s missing: an organic engine Sova owns

Reach from creators is rented. When a collab ends, nothing stays on Sova’s side.

In three months Sova posted 6 posts of its own, all on one day (11 Aug), averaging 8 likes + comments. Its creator collabs averaged about 198.

Sova has a scientist co-founder and 50+ gut nutritionists. None of them appear on its feed.

Proof

Organic works in gut health. The best brands here started as a person.

204kfollowers for @acanxa, built on one educational reel a day

Akanksha Pandey: content first, then her own gut brand

She built trust on Instagram, then founded The Gut IQ. Her personal content is now its funnel. 85 reels in 3 months, in two formats:

One food, one gut fact

Cinnamon, mushrooms, “tomatoes may worsen acidity”. No sales ask. Her biggest reach: about 1,600–2,000 likes each.

Symptom, then “Comment GUT”

Gut and hormones, insulin resistance. Ends with a comment keyword or the free assessment in bio: 73–113 comments, 5–7× her usual.

Dr Pal Manickam

Gastroenterologist → own brand

About 3.8M on YouTube and 2.2M on Instagram from gut-health education with humour. His bio lists his own brand, NewMe.

Vandita Tewari

Founder on camera → Iyurved

All 10 of Iyurved’s top posts feature the founder. Median 126 likes + comments a post, against Sova’s 8.

The pattern

Expert face → trust → sales

In gut health, people buy from someone they have watched explain their gut. Sova already has these experts on staff.

Add

Where Sova can start: one educational series from its own experts

Short, well-shot, recurring. Creators keep bringing reach; the series builds trust and collects leads Sova keeps.

Gut, Decoded

Fronted by co-founder Max Kushnir (the science) and Gargi Sareen, Head of Gut Health Experts (the practical answers).

Reach

Your kitchen, your gut

Jeera, curd, haldi doodh: what each does to the gut, in 30 seconds.

Lead

Symptom decoded

“Acidity every night but reports are normal?” Ends with “Comment GUT” for the free gut assessment.

Proof

Report decoded

An expert reads a real, anonymised Sova report on camera. Only Sova has this lab data.

Rhythm

3 a week

Numbered episodes and the same opening frame, so people come back for the next one.

Fix

The comments are backfiring on the collabs

I read every visible comment on Sova’s 9 biggest reels. 19 of 66 genuine comments, about 3 in 10, are complaints or open distrust: no report after a month, supplements 36 days late, “fraud”, “scam”. One customer posted the same complaint under 5 reels. Sova replied to none.

How the brand team turns this around

Answer every oneReply publicly from @sova_health within 24 hours. If customer care is slow, the brand team is there: acknowledge, take it to WhatsApp, then post “resolved” under the same comment.
Founder explainsA short founder video on what happens to your sample, day by day: pickup, DNA sequencing, expert review. Pin it and link it in replies.
One promiseOne report timeline everywhere. Today the product page says both 2–3 and 3–4 weeks, and both 50,000+ and 10,000+ customers.
Comments become contentThe most-asked questions in the comments become the next “Symptom decoded” episodes.
Measure

Branded search growthWeek-1 baselinePeople searching “Sova”: the brand stuck, not just the creator

Creators bring people to Sova. The series and the replies give them a reason to trust it.
